description: Derevi, Empyrial Tactician + Gaea's Cradle, single-attacker base case: Cradle tapped in precombat main (mana pool then empties per CR 500.5, but Cradle stays tapped), Derevi attacks alone and connects, its combat-damage trigger untaps Cradle, which is then tapped again for a second green mana within the same combat damage step. Validates INT-0011 (single-attacker case only - see the scope note in interactions/verified/INT-0011.json regarding the not-yet-engine-verified multi-attacker scaling claim).
artificial_state_elements: Only Derevi itself is on the battlefield as a creature (no other creatures for playerA), keeping Gaea's Cradle's own 'per creature you control' output at a simple, easy-to-check 1 green per activation.
playerB has no permanents, so Derevi's attack is trivially unblocked - blocking/combat-assignment mechanics are not material to this interaction.
No other permanents, hand cards, or players' boards were modeled.
material_characteristics: Derevi's triggered ability fires on a creature dealing combat damage to a player, offering a 'may tap or untap target permanent' choice
Gaea's Cradle's tapped/untapped status is a permanent characteristic that persists across steps and phases, unlike its produced mana (which empties at the end of each step/phase per CR 500.5/106.4)
Choosing 'untap' on an already-tapped Gaea's Cradle makes it available to tap for mana again within the same turn
abstracted_characteristics: Number of creatures controlled (kept at 1 for simplicity of the mana-per-creature math; more creatures would just scale Cradle's own output, not change the interaction's mechanism)
All board state not directly involved in the two-card interaction
The multi-attacker scaling case (whether N connecting attackers yield N untap-then-retap cycles) - not covered by this fixture; see INT-0011's scope note

legal_actions: Tap Gaea's Cradle for mana in the precombat main phase
Choose to untap Gaea's Cradle in response to Derevi's combat-damage trigger
Tap Gaea's Cradle for mana again in the combat damage step
illegal_actions_to_reject: Any implicit assumption that a permanent tapped earlier in the turn is unavailable again without an untap effect, or that mana produced pre-combat somehow persists into the combat damage step (it does not, per CR 500.5)
expected.outcome_if_resolved: By the combat damage step, after Derevi's trigger untaps Cradle and it is tapped again: exactly 1 green mana in the pool (the precombat green already emptied), and Gaea's Cradle remains on the battlefield, tapped a second time that turn.

rules_citations: CR 500.5 / 106.4 (a player's mana pool empties at the end of each step and phase)
CR 603.2c (an ability triggers once per occurrence of its trigger event)
